title: The Two-Sided Work
visualCarrier: full-frame open transition case with a release well and a selective carry-forward well
interaction: letting go creates the space that makes selective carry-forward useful
examples: finance P&L fluency becomes product judgment
live classroom feedback becomes instructional-design advantage
constraints: no progress rail, bar, trace, or moving dot
no false UI or decorative arrows
motion must change the explanatory model
no cramped card island or redundant prose
